facts.fact: ARPCE, the regulator, put its Pointe-Noire data centre (156 m2, 54 racks) into service on 28 February 2024; ARPCE's director general says it can host the data of public administration and of the private sector.
ARPCE describes its Pointe-Noire data centre, in service since 28 February 2024, as Tier 3+ (operator's own statement, no certification named).

note: Brazzaville ARPCE data centre is Tier 2 and no hire is stated, so no fact for it.
